connect.title: Connect Your Computer
connect.subtitle: Pair with Cinlan on your computer to view agents, access terminals, and advance work directly from your phone.
connect.step_1_desc: Go to Settings -> Mobile and generate a pairing QR code.
connect.step_2_desc: Tap the button above to open the camera and point at the QR code.
connect.step_3_desc: Your computer will appear here. Everything is end-to-end encrypted.

manual_pair.title: Connect with Pairing Code
manual_pair.desc: Due to camera restrictions or preference, enter the pairing code obtained from your desktop.

notifications.title: Never miss when agents need you
notifications.desc: Get notified on this phone when agents finish tasks or need assistance—even if the app is closed.
notifications.hint: Sent via Cinlan push notification service after 3 minutes of desktop idle. Change anytime in settings.
